Name: LongMemeory
Author: lillionx
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]A patch attached on Social Valley, meant to make NPCS can remember more and longer information. NPCS also can remember correct game info such as who are Abigail's parents and what's her likes or dislikes.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Download the Soclial Valley mod, which requires you to download Player2.

2. Download LM Studio or Ollama, choose a smaller LLM that you prefer. This mod was developed using qwen3:0.6b. Try not to make the model too large, otherwise it will put a heavy burden on your computer.

3. Modify config.json to ensure that your ExtractionBackend is set to Player2 and your RetrievalBackend is set to Ollama or LM Studio. Also, ensure that your URL and modelname are correct.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Persistent Memory: After interacting with an NPC, the dialogue is compressed and stored locally, organized by topic. Even after closing the game, the local LLM automatically indexes the dialogue and sends it to the cloud-based large model used by Social Valley, achieving a long-term memory effect.

2. Accurate Game Knowledge: The mod transforms game knowledge, such as NPC preferences and relationships, into a graph database. During dialogues, the local LLM can search for this information, ensuring accurate responses to NPC-related questions.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Ideally, you should have more than 2GB of VRAM, depending on the local LLM you are using.[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
